title: Direct isolate calls bypass harness argument policy and invocation admission
wanted_capability: Direct isolate TOOL --args and isolate --cell should exercise the same invocation path as the harness, including typed defaults, pins, validation, cancellation, and admission.
fallback_used: Used --cell and compared direct calls while inspecting results myself.
notes: Reproduced with default:file_read.max_lines=3. Direct call returned the ordinary 200-line page and accepted an invalid string default; cell mode returned three lines and rejected the string. Repair routes direct calls through start_tool_invocation.
resolution_note: Direct isolate calls now use start_tool_invocation, matching flat harness and cell admission. Rebuilt executable verified numeric defaults and invalid-policy refusal in both modes; reproducible checks are in scripts/audit-isolate-surface.py.
